# MOWIN

> > MOWIN is a professional yoga mat and fitness equipment customization supplier offering wholesale solutions for yoga, pilates, and activewear products.

MOWIN specializes in custom manufacturing and wholesale distribution of yoga mats, pilates equipment, and fitness accessories. The company offers extensive material options (rubber, POE, TPE, PVC) and serves both individual and bulk buyers seeking personalized fitness products.
